result.question: Hvor mange ekteskap ble inngått i 2025 der den eldste ektefellen var bosatt i Norge?
result.text:
I 2025 ble det inngått 21 574 ekteskap der den eldste ektefellens bostedskommune var i Norge [E7]. Tabellen «Inngåtte ekteskap, etter mannens bosted og år» bruker fra og med 2025 den eldste ektefellens bostedskommune, og «Hele landet» omfatter alle som er bosatt i Norge [E7].

Til sammenligning viser tabellen for ekteskap mellom ulike kjønn at 21 774 ekteskap hadde minst én part bosatt i Norge [E8]. De to tallene gjelder ulike avgrensninger: den første teller alle ekteskap (også likekjønnede) etter den eldste ektefellens bosted, den andre bare ekteskap mellom ulike kjønn etter om mannen eller kvinnen er bosatt i Norge.

result.question: What was the median income after tax of all households in Norway in 2024?

In constant prices the median is the same figure, NOK 676,100, since 2024 is the most recent year and the constant-price series is expressed in that year's prices [E4]. The table covers 2,616,826 households; student households and persons living alone below the age of majority are excluded [E4].

In 2023, 2024 and 2025 combined, 62,698 marriages were contracted [C1].

The yearly figures are 19,988 in 2023, 21,136 in 2024 and 21,574 in 2025 [E5]. These come from table 09659, which counts marriages by the oldest partner's place of residence (before 2025: the husband's residence in different-sex marriages), so the total covers marriages where the older spouse lived in Norway [E5]. The figures are rounded for privacy, so very small counts are rounded to either zero or three [E5].

result.question: Of the age groups less than 25 years, 25-39, 40-54, 55-66 and 67 years or older, which had the highest average monthly earnings for full-time employees in Norway in 2025?
result.text:
The **55-66 years** group had the highest average monthly earnings for full-time employees in 2025, at NOK 71,880 [C1] [E8].

Average monthly earnings for full-time employees, both sexes, all sectors, 2025 [C1] [E8]:

| Age group | Average monthly earnings (NOK) |
|---|---|
| 55-66 years | 71,880 [C1] [E8] |
| 67 years or older | 70,150 [C1] [E8] |
| 40-54 years | 69,800 [C1] [E8] |
| 25-39 years | 59,590 [C1] [E8] |
| Less than 25 years | 40,440 [C1] [E8] |

The three oldest groups are close together, while earnings are clearly lower for the two youngest groups [C1] [E8]. The figures come from table 13312, "Monthly earnings, by measuring method, working hours, sex, age, sector and year", last updated 5 February 2026 [E8].
